Yes, that balance is right. A bookmark with a giant title, a rambling description, and a pile of labels shouldn't blow up my whole list so one item hogs the screen and I lose the ability to skim everything else. Keeping it trimmed to a tidy, consistent size by default — but with a "Show full details" that opens up the complete title, the whole description, and any remaining labels when I actually want them — gives me both: quick skimming most of the time, and the full picture when I choose to look closer.

That's how I'd want it to cope with the occasional overly long entry — stay readable and even, and let me expand on demand rather than forcing all that text on me up front. Happy with this.
